title: Ethcode
tagline: One click Ethereum abstraction account paymaster template code generation tool
description:
- User can create abstraction account paymaster template, just using single command directly from VScode with the help of Ethcode plugin.
- Inbuilt wallet support for contract deployment and execution inside VScode.
how_its_made: As this ERC4337 is still under R&D phase and we don't have any proper documentation or application built on the top of abstraction account, we had lot of trouble understanding the functions of these smart contracts
